findings.canonical: Afterward, head left a bit more, then check the top barrel to the upper-right for a [_WITCH'S BROTH_]. ... then make your way back below deck to talk with Alice
findings.structured: Collect the Rosewood Bracelet and Witch's Broth below deck; Top barrel to the upper-right, after the scene with Margarete (step 1)
findings.issue: The source places the Witch's Broth barrel after the wheelhouse-door scene, not below deck (the source says to go back below deck afterwards), so 'below deck' is not source-supported for the Broth. The location also says 'after the scene with Margarete', whereas the source puts it after the wheelhouse door scene. Rosewood Bracelet 'below deck' is likewise inferred rather than stated.

findings.canonical: Alice should cast Holy Edge on Margarete first, so she has Light-based attacks, then she should cast Blessed Light.
findings.structured: Alice casts Holy Edge on Margaret, then Blessed Light.
findings.issue: Condensed paraphrase changes 'Margarete' to 'Margaret' in the Holy Edge target and rewrites source wording ('At least this time she won't use Dark Messenger' became 'Dark Messenger is not used this time'). The step-level strategies, which are the rendered content, keep the source prose and are correct.

findings.canonical: Choosing option 1 will allow you to see what items he has for sale. Make sure that you have THREE Rosewood Bracelets to put on your active party, as the next boss can paralyze you.
findings.structured: Step 4 (option 1 only) carries the warning about three Rosewood Bracelets and healing items.
findings.issue: The warning is general preparation advice for the next boss, but it is attached to the option 1 shop step only, which may read as conditional on picking option 1. Content is intact; placement is slightly misleading.
